title: 15 Annotations
subtitle: Stickies, arrows, marker, sections, stickers and AI on the layer above the design — a Homepage review on Studio site and the Combine 2026 plan on Alligators brand
brief: Michal, 2026-10-08: "jeste me doslo ze tam vubec neni navrh jak bude vypadat prace s artboards a annotations, jak bude vypadat ta samotna editace a objekty atd." — the ANNOTATIONS half (14 Editing draws artboards and objects). Preview's toolbar is annotation tools only, FigJam-style (CONTRACT §2): Hand · Sticky N · Comment C · Marker M · Arrow A · Shape · Text · Stickers E · Section S; the keys in Edit switch to Preview; View › Annotations ⇧P; Edit › Select all annotations ⇧⌘A. Every capability of today's whiteboard layer stays reachable: stickies, shapes, arrows (bound to board items today; to artboards and elements inside them — proposed), text, marker + highlighter, sections, groups, lock/unlock (⇧⌘L), templates (retro, kanban, flow…), the Stickers gallery (vote stamps + the four bundled packs, keyword search, 160 px drop), element context for AI (canvas-rects), AI reading (read-annotations) and writing (annotate), FigJam import (--from-figjam), comments vs annotations, opt-in export.

sections.title: When annotations meet the real world
sections.subtitle: An arrow whose button is gone · 200 stickies · a sticky on a video · a print artboard and export · someone who may only comment · a FigJam board arriving

artboards.label: 1 · N in Edit — Preview opens with Sticky in hand
artboards.note: Edit with quiet stickies → N → Preview with Sticky and its colours; no banner or toast — the toolbar, switch and brightening stickies are the signal; the design stays live; esc → Hand → Edit.

artboards.label: 2 · Stickies on and between artboards
artboards.note: On an artboard a sticky belongs to it (proposed — today it stays put); between artboards it stays on the canvas; dropped on another it stacks with an offset; typing grows it to five lines, then wider.

artboards.label: 3 · A sticky, up close
artboards.note: Auto-size, a stable ±2° tilt, stacking + Fan out, ten papers (five up front, +5 for white, grey, peach, aqua, pink; AI writes on paper with a spark edge), the author line (≥ 4.5:1 on every paper), and the selected sticky's toolbar (colour · size Small→Huge · list · Lock · Turn into a comment, proposed).

artboards.label: 4 · Everything the annotation layer already does — kept
artboards.note: Everything today's whiteboard does, kept and placed: Text (T, Small→Huge, 8–200), Shape (R, five kinds, fill + stroke apart, label inside), pictures and link cards (paste/drop), video/audio chips (drop a file), Group ⌘G / ⇧⌘G, align + distribute, dashed lines, bullet/number lists, the complete palettes, and where each lives.

artboards.label: 5 · An arrow to the button, not the artboard
artboards.note: PROPOSED: the end snaps to the element under it (the button, not the artboard) and names it; over an artboard's edge the whole artboard lights up. Today an arrow binds to board items only; a pointer end on the design is a fixed point.

artboards.label: 6 · Move the artboard — the arrow goes around Mobile, never through
artboards.note: PROPOSED (signature): Mobile sits squarely between Tereza's sticky and See the work. Three states of one drag — 0 ms (outline, straight down), 120 ms (outline, under Mobile), let go (over Mobile, shortest clean path, 160 ms); the straight line that would cross Mobile is shown and refused. Marker loop and sun sticky ride on Desktop; the loose note stays.

artboards.label: 7 · AI rewrites the button the arrow points at
artboards.note: PROPOSED: AI rewrites the button an arrow points at. Same element rewritten (bigger, “See our work”) → the arrow stays bound to its new version. Replaced by a different element (a sign-up field) → the arrow keeps its end, dashed: “Pointed at the old “See the work” — replaced by AI · Point to…”. Needs stable element ids through AI rewrites.

artboards.label: 8 · Edges, elbows, curves and labels
artboards.note: Edges (proposed), Straight · Curved · Elbow, labels on the line, six head styles — lines, heads and labels exist today; the ink row shows four with +5 for the rest.

artboards.label: 9 · Circle it, highlight it, rub it out
artboards.note: Marker · Highlighter · Eraser; nine inks with Ink (black) first and default, +4 for the rest; two marker widths. Strokes belonging to the artboard under them is proposed.

artboards.label: 10 · Tereza's feedback, wrapped in a section
artboards.note: Wrap in section or draw one with S; name, colour, ask AI about it. Folding to one line is proposed.

artboards.label: 11 · Start from a template
artboards.note: Section tool opens templates above the toolbar (or ⌘K); the pick follows the pointer; or describe it (in the project's language) and AI builds it with your items.

artboards.label: 12 · The Combine 2026 plan, next to the work
artboards.note: A kanban (Nápady · Rozpracované · Hotovo) colour-coded by channel, cards with stamps, arrows tying cards to the post and the leták they're about.

artboards.label: 13 · E opens the Stickers gallery
artboards.note: E opens one gallery: vote stamps (proposed) on top, Recent, then the four bundled packs with “by <author>” and a credits footer with each pack's source link, as the shipped picker shows.

artboards.label: 14 · Search “done” across every pack
artboards.note: Search reads each sticker's keywords across all packs and the stamps: “done” → 6 Project status stickers with their keywords, matched words as chips with counts; the other packs step aside; “hotovo” finds nothing and says the words are English.

artboards.label: 15 · Done — a Project status sticker on the post, at 160 px
artboards.note: A Project status sticker lands at 160 px, selected; context toolbar Replace… · Flip · Lock · Duplicate. Never part of the design.

artboards.label: 16 · Three jersey directions, voted with stamps
artboards.note: PROPOSED (stamps as an element type): six stamps with faces; the gallery folds to the stamp row after one; several gather into a count, one per person per kind; hover lists who.

artboards.label: 17 · Start a vote — three directions, three votes each
artboards.note: PROPOSED: Start a vote on three selected artboards (right-click › Start a vote…, or ⌘K) — 3 votes each, 2 min, others' votes hidden until the end, End vote; at 0:00 every count shows and the result stays as a section AI can read (last week's helmet vote shown on the canvas).

artboards.label: 18 · People talk, people draw
artboards.note: Comment (a thread pinned to a spot) beside annotation (a mark on the layer), then a table: where it lives, tools, who can, talking, done, show/hide, AI, export.

artboards.label: 19 · A sticky becomes a comment
artboards.note: PROPOSED: a sticky becomes a comment thread where its arrow pointed (or where it sat), signed by its author — “From Jonas's sticky · turned into a comment by You”; the sticky goes to the trash; a thread's ⋯ turns it back.

artboards.label: 20 · AI reads three stickies
artboards.note: Three stickies selected become the Ask AI scope; AI outlines the hero picture they mean in spark, says what they ask in one line and offers Make these changes.

artboards.label: 21 · AI makes the change in Edit — the stickies stay, resolved
artboards.note: Edit: the hero picture fills the right half; the three answered stickies are resolved (ticked, struck through, kept); the layer is quiet in Edit; the open sticky is offered as a chip.

artboards.label: 22 · AI marks what it resolved with a status sticker
artboards.note: AI resolves the stickies it answered, places Done! and Flagged (on the one that needs your call) with a spark; voice: “Warmer sun?” is flagged — that one is your call. Exports leave stickers out unless included.

artboards.label: 23 · AI writes a review as notes with arrows
artboards.note: AI reviews Pricing as notes with a spark edge and spark arrows to what each means. Binding those ends to elements is proposed; today they are fixed points.

artboards.label: 24 · Only Tereza's, and a locked sticky
artboards.note: Layers in Preview lists the annotation layer by section with a person filter (Tereza) — others hidden, not gone; a locked sticky resists a drag with one line and Unlock ⇧⌘L.

artboards.label: 25 · Quiet in Edit, hidden with ⇧P, all with ⇧⌘A, cleared with ⌘K
artboards.note: Preview full strength · Edit quiet (faded paper, readable words ≥ 4.5:1, click-through) · ⇧P hides in any mode · ⇧⌘A selects all · ⌘K “resolved” moves resolved stickies to the trash. Comment pins: Edit and Preview, never Present.

artboards.label: 26 · The button it pointed at is in the trash
artboards.note: PROPOSED (bound to a button inside an artboard): Book a call moved to the trash; the arrow keeps its end, dashed, names what it meant; Point to… re-aims; restoring re-attaches.

artboards.label: 27 · 200 stickies, zoomed out
artboards.note: At 9 % stickies draw as colour blocks; each section shows its count; hover says who's in it; words return when legible.

artboards.label: 28 · A sticky on a video, pinned to 0:12
artboards.note: PROPOSED: a sticky placed on a playing video is pinned to that moment and fades at other times; the timeline marks notes and comments.

artboards.label: 29 · Print artboards — notes stay outside, exports leave them out
artboards.note: Notes over a print area say “Not printed”. Export: Include annotations is off and unavailable for print files (“Print files never carry them — pick PDF for a review copy”) — same row as 09 Export.

artboards.label: 30 · Can comment — Hand and Comment only
artboards.note: Can comment sees everyone's annotations read-only with Hand + Comment; N answers "Stickies need Can edit." with Ask to edit.

artboards.label: 31 · A FigJam board arrives as annotations
artboards.note: A FigJam link through Import from Figma… arrives editable as annotations in one section, authors kept; widgets — like Figma frames — arrive as pictures.
